$jsonSchema.description: Stores information users. Each document is one user.

version.description: tracks which version of this collection this document is from

phone.description: the user's phone number, formatted to: +XXX (XXX) XXX-XXXX

email.description: the user's email, formatted to email regex

nutrition_goals.description: Contains the data for the user's nutritional goals

min.description: the amount of carbohydrates (milligrams) the user wants to get at minimum in a day

max.description: the amount of carbohydrates (milligrams) the user wants to get at most in a day

min.description: the amount of protein (milligrams) the user wants to get at minimum in a day

max.description: the amount of protein (milligrams) the user wants to get at most in a day

calorie.description: the user's desired daily calories (in tenths of a calorie)

min.description: the amount of calories (in tenths of a calorie) the user wants to get at minimum in a day

max.description: the amount of calories (in tenths of a calorie) the user wants to get at most in a day

min.description: the amount of fat (milligrams) the user wants to get at minimum in a day

max.description: the amount of fat (milligrams) the user wants to get at most in a day

finances.description: information on the user's finances including available budget and finance goals

balance.description: the user's balance of dining dollars in cents

goals.description: The user's finance goals, including daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly spend

daily.description: the most the user wants to spend in a day in cents

weekly.description: the most the user wants to spend in a week in cents

monthly.description: the most the user wants to spend in a month in cents

yearly.description: the most the user wants to spend in a year in cents
